metadata.name: reference-env
metadata.description: Born-locked secret materialization — cofre owns secret BIRTH; ESO (ClusterSecretStore(Akeyless)) reconciles into the k8s Secrets the pods mount. No stringData Secret is hand-applied.

secrets.name: mysql-root-password
secrets.description: MySQL root@'%' password — db_pwd for every service + every inter-service <x>_db_pwd handle (akeyless-mysql-root/root-password).

secrets.name: db-encryption-key
secrets.description: INTERIM cofre stored secret (AES-256 DEK). Selo custody destination is KFM-SPLIT (uam checkUamDbEncryptKey derives fragments across kfm1db/kfm2db), NOT an ESO-materialized stored secret — do not enshrine.

secrets.name: neo4j-password
secrets.description: Neo4j requirepass — also sdr's sdr_db_pwd (one material, two consume sites).

secrets.name: uam-redis-password
secrets.description: requirepass for uam's dedicated TLS redis — uam-secret.conf redis_password.

secrets.name: uam-auth-shared-encryption-key
secrets.description: AES-SIV key shared by auth+uam for the create-account ceremony (uam_auth_shared_encryption_key). PreSharedKey materializes url-safe base64 (32 bytes) — +//-free by construction; the akeyless decode variant is a live-verify.

secrets.name: stats-splunk-token
secrets.description: bis stats_splunk_token — MUST equal Vector's splunk_hec valid_tokens allowlist ("x" today), not a randomly-generated secret. Bridges bis's Splunk-HEC-shaped stats into Vector -> ClickHouse/VictoriaLogs; no real Splunk involved.

secrets.name: uam-api-key
secrets.description: uam service RSA private half (uam-secret.conf api_key). PROCEDURAL residue — born by the uam-access provision step's RSA keypair, NOT by cofre; cofre tracks + verifies the path only.

secrets.name: uam-access-id
secrets.description: uam service access_id (uam-secret.conf access_id). DETERMINISTIC (UamAccessID(env)) — cofre tracks, does not birth.

secrets.name: gateway-access-key
secrets.description: akeyless-gateway-creds gateway-access-key = the admin RSA private half — client-owned, known offline (the create-account admin keypair); cofre tracks, does not birth.

secrets.name: gateway-access-id
secrets.description: akeyless-gateway-creds gateway-access-id = the ceremony-returned AdminAccessID (server-generated, NOT known offline). LiveTODO: the create-account ceremony returns it, then cofre writes it to this path, then ESO materializes akeyless-gateway-creds.

secrets.name: rabbitmq-admin-password
secrets.description: akeyless-rabbitmq-admin password — RABBIT-ERA. Retired by drift instance #1 (rabbit→nats/escuta); covered for the rabbit era, not enshrined.
